game_title: Countdown Launch – Torchlit Cave Mouth Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth, the torchlit cave entrance: the torchbearer must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Countdown Launch: Tick a countdown down each loop until it hits zero and the launch fires.
theme: Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth: the torchlit cave entrance
core_gameplay_loop: In Torchlit Cave Mouth, repeat each round: Tick a countdown down each loop until it hits zero and the launch fires. Each round, a new crystal shards challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the count value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 340 points of crystal shards by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Countdown Launch
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how count changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Torchlit Cave Mouth.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 340 within 48 seconds.
